google_review_notes: No login required. All features of Block Puzzle are reachable from the main menu: Play (Classic runs), Daily puzzle, Shop, Themes and Settings. Score-based block puzzle with AdMob ads (banner, interstitial, optional rewarded videos for revives and boosters) and optional in-app purchases.
apple_review_notes: No login required. To test IAPs, open the Shop from Block Puzzle's main menu. Restore Purchases is in Settings. No demo account needed.
